notes: All values are mean ± std over seeds. Test = final evaluation, run once after selection on validation.
Table A: every model predicts by argmax of its class probabilities.
Table B: every model uses the same rule with t_high and t_low tuned on the validation set, separately for each model and seed, then applied once to the test set.
PR-AUC and ROC-AUC do not depend on the decision rule, so they are identical in both tables.
RF (unconstrained) has no CV (final fit per seed only).
